name: Confirmation
layerWhy: It asks one question; the action it confirms is its own kind.
promise: An irreversible action waits for one deliberate yes.
expectation: A dialog whose answers repeat the action, the safe one first in focus.
evidence: Resolves true only for its confirm; every way out is false; focus starts on the safe answer for a destructive one.
behaviour: Its confirm is the final danger fill for a destructive action.
context: Only for what cannot be undone.
do: Say what is lost in the body.

inputs: PrimalConfirm.ask({ title, body, confirm, cancel, kind })
